pokemon_scp.name: Kabutops
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0141 is to be contained in a reinforced aquatic combat vault with high-speed motion sensors. Personnel must not enter without full hazard armor.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0141 is a revived fossil organism with scythe-like forearms capable of slicing reinforced steel. Displays predatory behavior and extreme agility both in water and on land.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive and silent. Frequently stalks personnel from submerged positions.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0141-A: SCP-0141 severed a containment drone in a single strike.
Addendum 0141-B: Hydrodynamic movement suggests evolutionary optimization for ambush predation.

pokemon_scp.name: Aerodactyl
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0142 is to be contained in an aerial vault with reinforced steel supports and shock-resistant glass. Personnel must avoid aerial pursuit zones.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0142 is a revived pterosaur-like organism with serrated teeth capable of penetrating titanium. Flight speed exceeds 120 km/h indoors.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Extremely aggressive. Displays territorial aerial dominance and coordinated dive attacks.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0142-A: SCP-0142 shattered a reinforced observation window during a dive.
Addendum 0142-B: Screech frequencies induce panic responses in exposed personnel.

pokemon_scp.name: Snorlax
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0143 is to be contained in a reinforced mammalian vault with structural load-bearing supports. Personnel must avoid waking SCP-0143 abruptly.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0143 is a massive mammalian organism with extreme body mass and anomalous metabolic efficiency. When asleep, SCP-0143 becomes immovable by conventional means.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Docile when fed. Aggressive when disturbed during sleep cycles.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0143-A: SCP-0143 blocked a containment hallway for 16 hours.
Addendum 0143-B: Heart rate remains stable regardless of physical exertion.

pokemon_scp.name: Articuno
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0144 cannot be reliably contained. Partial containment relies on climate monitoring and emergency frost-zone evacuation protocols.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0144 is a legendary avian organism capable of generating blizzards and cryogenic storms. Wingbeats reduce ambient temperature by up to 40°C instantly.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Silent and aloof. Appears to ignore containment attempts entirely.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0144-A: SCP-0144’s passage froze an entire forest overnight.
Addendum 0144-B: Cryogenic feathers show molecular structures unknown to science.

pokemon_scp.name: Zapdos
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0145 cannot be contained. Partial containment relies on atmospheric monitoring and lightning-strike prediction systems.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0145 is a legendary avian organism composed of electrically charged plumage. Capable of generating continent-scale thunderstorms and lightning strikes exceeding 300 million volts.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive and unpredictable. Appears drawn to high-voltage environments.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0145-A: SCP-0145’s lightning strike disabled a regional power grid.
Addendum 0145-B: Electromagnetic readings spike hours before SCP-0145 appears.

pokemon_scp.name: Moltres
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0146 cannot be contained. Partial containment relies on wildfire suppression teams and thermal satellite tracking.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0146 is a legendary avian organism composed of living flame. Wingbeats ignite the surrounding air, creating firestorms capable of consuming entire landscapes.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Majestic but destructive. Displays territorial behavior over volcanic regions.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0146-A: SCP-0146 ignited a mountain range during migration.
Addendum 0146-B: Flame samples show plasma-like properties.

pokemon_scp.name: Dratini
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0147 is to be contained in a freshwater serpentine enclosure. Personnel may interact with SCP-0147 under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0147 is a serpentine organism with smooth scales and mild hydrokinesis. Displays rapid growth and high resilience.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Gentle and shy. Frequently hides beneath water surfaces.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0147-A: SCP-0147 shed a scale with anomalous regenerative properties.
Addendum 0147-B: Hydrokinesis formed spiral water patterns.

pokemon_scp.name: Dragonair
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0148 is to be contained in a large serpentine vault with atmospheric monitoring. Personnel must avoid touching SCP-0148’s crystalline nodes.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0148 can manipulate weather patterns through crystalline nodes along its body. Displays mild levitation and electrical discharge capabilities.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Calm and graceful. Atmospheric disturbances correlate with SCP-0148’s emotional state.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0148-A: SCP-0148 generated a localized storm within containment.
Addendum 0148-B: Crystalline node samples refract light into unknown spectral ranges.

pokemon_scp.name: Dragonite
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0149 is to be contained in a titan-grade aerial vault with reinforced supports. Personnel must avoid provoking SCP-0149.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0149 is a large draconic organism capable of extreme flight speed and immense physical strength. Displays intelligence comparable to humans and advanced problem-solving skills.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Friendly when calm, catastrophic when angered. Shows awareness of containment weaknesses.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0149-A: SCP-0149 lifted a 12-ton cargo container effortlessly.
Addendum 0149-B: SCP-0149 attempted to negotiate release with containment staff.

pokemon_scp.name: Mewtwo
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0150 cannot be contained. Partial containment relies on psychic dampeners, negotiation protocols, and global monitoring.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0150 is a genetically engineered psychic organism with power surpassing all known entities. Capable of telekinesis, mind control, and large-scale reality alteration.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Cold, analytical, and self-aware. Displays contempt for containment and expresses philosophical interest in human behavior.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0150-A: SCP-0150 disabled all psychic dampeners simultaneously.
Addendum 0150-B: SCP-0150 claims to perceive 'the architecture of consciousness'.

pokemon_scp.name: Mew
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0151 is not to be forcibly contained. SCP-0151 cooperates with Foundation personnel and may be summoned via harmonic resonance protocols.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0151 is a small psychic organism capable of molecular-level shapeshifting, levitation, and reality-neutralizing abilities. Genetic structure contains markers for all known evolutionary paths.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Playful, curious, and benevolent. Frequently assists in neutralizing minor anomalies.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0151-A: SCP-0151 neutralized a Class-II spatial anomaly effortlessly.
Addendum 0151-B: SCP-0151’s DNA contains sequences matching multiple SCP entities.
